DEFENDANT -
53 Cohansey Holding LLC, A New Jersey Limited Liability Company, et als
By virtue of a Alias Writ of Execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public venue at the Salem County Courthouse, situated at No. 92 Market Street, in the City of Salem, New Jersey on
Monday,
October 19, 2026
at
2 o’clock
in the afternoon, ALL the following lot, tract or parcel of land and premises, situate, lying and being in the Township of Alloway, in the County of Salem and State of New Jersey, bounded and described as follows:
Municipality: Alloway
County of Salem
State of New Jersey
Street and Street No.: 53 Cohansey-Friesburg Road Alloway, NJ 08001, with a mailing address of 53 Cohansey- Friesburg Road Bridgeton, NJ 08302
Tax Block and Lot No.: Block 111, Lot 6.01
Dimensions of Lot (approximately): 1 AC
Nearest Cross Street: Pecks Corner-Cohansey Road
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the offices of the County Clerk and the Sheriff of Salem County.
The approximate amount of the judgment to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of $205,410.88 together with the costs of this sale.
The approximate upset price is $253,300.46.
The upset price may be subject to further Orders of additional sums.
The occupancy status of the property being foreclosed herein is presently unknown
Beginning at a point in the Westerly line of the Cohansey-Friesburg Road (aka Cohansey-Aldine Road, aka County Road No. 635) (49.50 feet wide), said point being distant the two following described courses and distances from the intersection of the center line of said Cohansey- Friesburg Road and the physical center line of Harmersville-Cohansey Road (49.50 feet wide, aka County Road No. 540); Course One: Measured along said center line of the Cohansey-Friesburg Road (aka Cohansey- Aldine Road), North 12 degrees 15 minutes East 932 feet, to a point in said center line; Course Two: North 77 degrees 45 minutes West 24.75 feet to the point and place of beginning; and from beginning runs; thence
Prior Liens/Encumbrances
3rd QTR Taxes Open Plus Penalty $1,069.31
Total as of September 4,2026: $1,069.31
Terms of Sale: 20% of bid in cash, certified check or cashiers check from the successful bidder upon conclusion of sale. The Sheriff’s Office cash limit is $1,000.00 The balance is due within 30 days of the date of sale.
Surplus Money:
If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to the Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The Sheriff reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
Fein, Such, Kahn & Shepard, P.C.
, Attorneys for Plaintiff
Charles M. Miller, Sheriff
